# Evidence images (generated by the host software renderer)

Camera: PAE CameraProtocol::fixedViews() (7 views) plus `side-right`; one shared orthographic frame per view over base and combined variants. Clay shading and light are PAE's ClayRenderer formula. This is NOT the Android GLES3 renderer.
